# Confirm expired draft announcements survive a page reload

## What & Why
Draft recovery expiry is covered during route history traversal, but a reload boundary should also prove that expired notices cannot return and that the unavailable announcement remains clear.

## Done looks like
- Expired answer drafts stay unavailable after reload and route navigation
- Expired opportunity drafts stay unavailable after reload and route navigation
- The existing recovery-announcement selectors are used for accessible verification
